# sspi_restore (Resource)

Restores the SSPI appliance from a previously created backup.

Restore records are immutable audit trails: this resource has no `Update` (any attribute change forces replacement) and no remote `Delete` — there is no `DELETE /sspi/restore/status/{id}` API, so destroying this resource only removes it from Terraform state.

Corresponds to `POST /sspi/restore` and `GET /sspi/restore/status/{id}`.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `backup_id` (String) Unique ID of the successful backup job to restore from.

### Optional

- `action` (String) Restore action trigger. The SSPI API currently supports only `RESTORE`. Defaults to `RESTORE`.
- `force_restore` (Boolean) When true, bypasses non-fatal validation warnings during restore.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique ID of the restore execution job.
- `progress` (Number) Percentage progress of the restore operation.
- `status` (String) Status of the restore execution (`SUCCESS`, `FAILED`, `IN_PROGRESS`, `QUEUED`, `NOT_STARTED`, `COMPLETED_WITH_ERRORS`).
